title: Profitable Trade
body:
# 💎 Profitable Trade
**Profitable Trade is the ultimate trading companion for Minecraft that transforms chaotic villager interfaces into clear, actionable data. Stop guessing if an enchanted book is a "deal" or a "scam" — let the mod do the math for you.**

## 🚀 Key Features
**📊 Dual-Panel Analytics. Two clean, dark panels appear to the left of the villager UI, providing critical insights:**

### Technical Panel:

> CAN BUY: Shows exactly how many units you can afford right now, based on the resources in your inventory.

> TRADES: Displays the remaining stock before the trade locks (e.g., 12/12).

### Status Panel:

> Instant trade quality assessment with intuitive color coding.

## ⌨️ Full Customization
1. Toggle Key: Hide or show the panels whenever you want. The default key is H.
 
2. Keybinds: Fully rebindable via the standard Minecraft Controls menu (Category: ProfitableTrade).
 
3. Status Notifications: A sleek overlay message appears above your hotbar when toggling: Panels: ON/OFF.

## 📜 Trade Analysis & Grades
**The mod analyzes every offer and assigns a status based on base prices and rarity:**

- 📚 **Librarians** (Enchanted Books)
The mod calculates the minimum and maximum possible base price for every enchantment level, factoring in whether it's a "Treasure" enchantment.

> ✨ GOD ROLL (Pink): The lowest possible price (or very close to it). A must-buy!
> 
> 🟡 MID GRADE (Yellow): An average price. Acceptable if you're not looking to min-max.
> 
> 🔴 BAD ROLL (Red): Significant overpayment. Better to reset the workstation.

- 🥦 **Farmers & Crafters** (Resources for Emeralds)
Evaluates your goods based on standard market rates:

> 📈 PROFIT (Green): The villager offers an excellent rate (e.g., less than 32 sticks per emerald).
> 
> ⚖️ FAIR TRADE (White): Standard market price.
> 
> 📉 SCAM (Red): An unfair rate. This villager is trying to rip you off.

- 🛠 **Equipment & Items**
  
> 🏷️ DISCOUNT (Cyan): Shows your specific discount percentage (e.g., 20% OFF) after curing a zombie villager.
> 
> 💸 OVERPRICED (Orange): Price is higher than the base rate (due to high demand or if the villager is annoyed).

### 🔒 Stock Management
**🚫 LOCKED: If a trade is sold out, the mod marks it as OUT OF STOCK so you don't waste your time.**

## 🛠 **Installation**
- Install Fabric API.
- Drop the jar file into your mods folder.
- Start trading like a pro!
- Happy trading! Now, no villager will ever trick you again. 🙌
